stepBody: Wesley has $$n$$ $$=$$ $$30$$ unique data points and $$2$$ features. He fits the following OLS model: $$\hat{y}_i $$=$$ \hat{\theta}_0 + \hat{\theta}_1(x_{i1})**{3} + \hat{\theta}_2 $$\ln$$ x_{i2}$$\n\nWesley correctly calculates a unique optimal solution for his OLS model.
